source.author: lucan
source.text: Vobis auctoribus, umbrae Non tacitas Erebi sedes Ditisque profundi Pallida regna petunt: regit idem spiritus artus Orbe alio: longae canitis si cognita vitae Mors media est.
source.text_original: Vobis auctoribus, umbrae / Non tacitas Erebi sedes Ditisque profundi / Pallida regna petunt: regit idem spiritus artus / Orbe alio: longae (canitis si cognita) vitae / Mors media est.
source.text_english: At your instigation, shades seek not the silent dwellings of Erebus but the pale realms of deep Dis, the same spirit governs their limbs in another world: if you sing things known to a long life, death is only the middle point.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_original: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, / quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras / et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_english: but their brother Lynceus is preserved for great uses, whom Arene bore, who can split the earth and, with his sight sent across, detect silent Styx.
